abilities.name: Glacial Path
notes:
Lissandra can reactivate Glacial Path for the duration (plus another 0.2-0.3 seconds after the claw 'sinks' into the ground).
  - The Claw can also hit enemies near the end point at this time, shortly after the missile has reached its maximum range.
Glacial Path cannot be recast while grounded or rooted.

evidence.quote: Frozen Thralls are ice spirits that have 33.475 / 78.65 / 117.325 / 149.825 / 177.775 / 201.175 / 221.325 / 238.225 / 252.85 / 263.9 / 275.6 / 284.7 / 292.175 / 298.675 / 303.875 / 308.75 / 325 (based on seconds alive) movement speed and slow nearby enemies by 25%.

abilities.name: Ice Shard

evidence.quote: Active: Lissandra launches a shard of ice in the target direction that deals magic damage and slows enemies hit for 1.5 seconds.

notes: Ice Shard picks a location 950 units away in the direction of the cast for the shattered missile to end up at.

The initial Ice Shard missile has a range of 700 units which it arrives at after 0.33. If it hasn't collided with an enemy in this path when it does, it checks for enemies in a 100 radius around the point 25 units in front of it.
  - Colliding or hitting an enemy in either fashion creates a new "shattered" missile with the same speed but greater width that continues to travel along the same line to the designated point 950 units from the cast's original position, originating at the location at which the initial missile collided at.
Spell shield will block the damage and the slow but will not stop the projectile from shattering.

abilities.name: Frozen Tomb

evidence.quote: Enemy Cast: Lissandra freezes the target enemy champion, knocking them down and stunning them for 1.5 seconds.

Frozen Tomb creates a field of ice that spreads out from the target over 1.5 seconds and covers the surrounding area for 3 seconds, dealing magic damage to enemies and slowing them for 0.5 seconds, refreshing every 0.25 seconds while they remain.
Enemy Cast: Lissandra freezes the target enemy champion, knocking them down and stunning them for 1.5 seconds.
Self Cast: Lissandra instantly entombs herself in ice, entering stasis for 2.5 seconds and healing herself every 0.25 seconds over the duration.
Self Cast: Lissandra instantly entombs herself in ice, entering stasis for 2.5 seconds and healing herself every 0.25 seconds over the duration.

notes: Spell shield will block the single-targeted portion and the radiating ice damage, but will not stop it from spreading.

If the target becomes untargetable, dies, or is too far away during the cast time, this ability will cancel but does not go on cooldown nor pay its cost.
  - The ability is not cancelled by loss of sight of the target.
  - This only applies to the enemy cast.
When becoming untargetable, Lissandra destroys enemy projectiles targeting her.
